description:
Start paid Runway Enhance Frame Rate (POST /api/v1/videos/enhance-frame-rate/generations, model="enhance-frame-rate").

First call estimate_video_enhance_frame_rate with the same owned video_url (<= 300 s, <= 4096 px per side)
and target_framerate (23_98, 24, 25, 29_97, 30, 48, 50, 59_94, 60, or 120). Supports optional max_cost_rub
and webhook_url. Returns a job ID; read get_video.

max_cost_rub.description: Optional maximum approved price in RUB from /videos/enhance-frame-rate/estimate.
max_cost_rub.title: Max Cost Rub

video_url.description: Owned Arckep storage key or URL of a source video (<=300 s, <=4K per side, <=200 MB).
video_url.title: Video Url

webhook_url.description: Optional HTTPS webhook URL notified when the job finishes.
webhook_url.title: Webhook Url

name: create_video_enhance_frame_rate
